title: Golden Sun: Dark Dawn
subtitle: The next generation of Adepts
summary: Golden Sun: Dark Dawn is Camelot's Nintendo DS role-playing adventure set thirty years after the first two Golden Sun games. Descendants of the earlier heroes travel through a changed Weyard, carrying forward the elemental powers known as Psynergy. The new generation makes the journey approachable without abandoning the series' central ideas. Turn-based battles share the adventure with environmental puzzles, and the same magic can have a practical use outside combat. Progress is measured both by a stronger party and by the places its abilities now allow it to reach.
body: Golden Sun: Dark Dawn is Camelot's Nintendo DS role-playing adventure set thirty years after the first two Golden Sun games. Descendants of the earlier heroes travel through a changed Weyard, carrying forward the elemental powers known as Psynergy. The new generation makes the journey approachable without abandoning the series' central ideas. Turn-based battles share the adventure with environmental puzzles, and the same magic can have a practical use outside combat. Progress is measured both by a stronger party and by the places its abilities now allow it to reach.

Psynergy is used to manipulate the environment, making a dungeon's arrangement something the party can gradually alter. New powers are gained through development or important items, and another ability can reveal a route or secret previously out of reach. The DS gives these interactions a different physical presentation from the Game Boy Advance games. The recurring question remains clear: which property of this place can an elemental skill affect? Exploration works best when the player treats a spell as a possible tool before thinking of it as another attack.

Elemental Djinn augment the party's powers, connecting the search for small creatures to the way characters perform in battle. Equipment, supportive magic and offensive abilities provide further choices when the party meets monsters. An encyclopedia records returning concepts and new information, helping a newcomer follow the world that the earlier adventures established. Dark Dawn brings that world into three-dimensional environments while keeping its distinctive relationship between magic and travel. A useful discovery can improve the next fight, but it may also change the way a familiar obstacle is approached.
story_headings: A spell can open another route
